department: School of Physical and Mathematical Sciences (SPMS) — Division of Physics and Applied Physics

deadline.value: August 2027 intake deadline is January 31, 2027 (application period October to January; January intake June to July).

also.quote: There are two application periods each year: October to January (for admission in August), and June to July (for admission in January).

gre_subject.value: SPMS Physics PhD lists only general GRE/GATE as optional and does not require the GRE Physics Subject Test.
gre_subject.quote: [Optional] GRE/GATE test scores - Demonstrating strong quantitative, verbal, or analytical skills through the submission of will enhance your application.

also.quote: A Graduate Record Examinations (GRE) test score of 319 (Verbal and Quantitative Reasoning) + 3.5 (Analytical Writing) and above is strongly encouraged.

supervisor.value: Applicants are admitted to the Division of Physics and Applied Physics PhD only if a faculty member agrees to be their research supervisor before formal application.
supervisor.quote: Graduate students are admitted into the Division of Physics and Applied Physics only if a faculty member agrees to be the research supervisor. | Once a faculty member has agreed to accept you as a graduate student, you may start the formal application process.

funding.value: Full-time PhD students are eligible on a competitive basis for the NTU Research Scholarship (S$3,000/month for international students, plus up to S$500/month after passing the Qualifying Examination, and annual tuition fee coverage for up to 4 years; S$3,400 PR / S$3,800 Singapore Citizen), as well as the Nanyang President's Graduate Scholarship and Provost Graduate Award (S$4,300/month international).
funding.quote: The NTU Research Scholarship is assigned by the School, and may be offered to applicants during the PhD programme application process (subject to limited availability).

also.quote: The NTU Research Scholarship is awarded to outstanding graduate students for research. | In addition to the monthly stipend, the award also covers the annual tuition fee.

entry_route.value: Direct PhD entry from a BSc in Physics or related discipline with minimum Honours (Distinction); an MSc is optional and not mandatory.
entry_route.quote: Applicants may optionally have a MSc degree in physics or a related discipline, but this is not mandatory.

notes: SPMS Physics strictly requires faculty supervisor agreement prior to starting the formal application, and requires at least one first-author paper publication for August 2024+ cohorts.
